fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. CCAF foot platoons anchor the Confederation's garrison network, holding worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they depend on prepared positions and local knowledge to offset their lack of mobility. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile. Equipped with man-portable anti-aircraft weapons, these platoons provide ground formations with a dedicated air defense capability against low-flying VTOLs and conventional aircraft.
